connector.name: Bls Labor MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Fetch US Bureau of Labor Statistics data - CPI, unemployment, wages, JOLTS, and more via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at bls-labor.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package bls-labor-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
